title: Pin version before coding
action: Use explicit version and verify each overload against same-version reference; if unavailable mark blocked.
why: Legacy and current signatures differ.
test: Compile in target version and record evidence.

title: Think in series
action: Treat close[1] as preceding bar history, not an array element; handle initial missing values.
why: Pine executes across bars, with separate realtime updates.
test: Synthetic warm-up and closed-bar comparison.

title: Respect qualifiers
action: Trace strongest qualifier of an expression before passing lengths, symbols or plot titles; do not cast blindly.
why: Many APIs require weaker qualifiers.
test: Read exact overload and test dynamic inputs.

title: Hoist stateful calls
action: Compute moving averages, RSI and crosses on each bar, then apply gating.
why: v6 lazy boolean evaluation can skip evaluations needed for history.
test: Compare gated and ungated feature series.

title: Use typed missing values
action: Declare initial na with explicit type and check na(x), not numeric substitutes.
why: Missing and zero have different meanings.
test: Zero and missing fixture.

title: Choose var deliberately
action: Use var for cross-bar persistence; use ordinary declarations for per-execution values.
why: Persistent state must not reset inadvertently.
test: Reload and compare known closed-bar events.

title: Treat varip as intrabar-only unless proved
action: Describe what cannot be reconstructed after reload; never infer historical tick sequence.
why: Realtime intrabar state differs from history.
test: Live log versus reload; do not expect identity for tick-only state.

title: Guard collection reads
action: Check size before get, pop or shift; cap growth.
why: Empty arrays and unbounded memory break scripts.
test: Empty, one element and capacity tests.

title: Use functions with clear contracts
action: Specify units, na behavior and qualifiers; avoid hidden state unless needed.
why: Simplifies parity and tests.
test: Verify caller behavior across chart contexts.

title: Confirm chart signals
action: Separate provisional values from confirmed signals; barstate.isconfirmed at chart scope only for this purpose.
why: Open-bar values can change.
test: Compare realtime close versus reload.

title: Use confirmed HTF pattern
action: For strictly higher TF, request the previous expression value with lookahead_on and guard timeframe.
why: Unshifted lookahead_on may expose future history.
test: Test HTF boundary, same/lower rejection, reload.

title: Do not confuse offsets
action: Offset expression inside request context, not result after request, when retrieving prior HTF expression.
why: A chart-bar shift is not an HTF-bar shift.
test: Compare against native HTF close.

title: Request lower timeframe arrays
action: Use security_lower_tf for available intrabars when needed; check counts and missingness.
why: One LTF sample is not all intrabars.
test: Test low-liquidity periods and empty arrays.

title: Separate pivot anchor from discovery
action: Store confirmation time and original pivot time separately; never backdate tradable signal.
why: Right-side pivot confirmation requires later observations.
test: Replay right-strength delay.

title: Use actual timestamps
action: Store exchange/timezone/session assumptions; distinguish event, receipt and availability timestamps.
why: A feature may not be observable at its chart anchor.
test: DST, overnight and session-boundary tests.

title: Tag feed and units
action: Use venue-qualified symbols, quote currency, contract type, units and feature source.
why: Spot, perpetual and aggregated values are not interchangeable.
test: Cross-feed and missing-data comparison.

title: Reject synthetic orderflow claims
action: Label OHLCV-derived delta or liquidity as proxy; use verified footprint/feed features only when supported.
why: A bar-derived estimate is not an exchange L2/L3 book.
test: Compare availability and provenance; do not claim hidden orders.

title: Check footprint availability
action: Verify current signature, plan, feed, na handling and request-count restrictions; test on supported symbol.
why: Footprint may be unavailable or request composition may exceed restrictions.
test: Missing-feed and single-request probe.

title: Distinguish RVOL definitions
action: Specify baseline (including/excluding current bar, session-adjusted or not) and zero-volume policy.
why: Different definitions produce different numbers.
test: Known window fixture and no-volume case.

title: Separate calculation from rendering
action: Compute features regardless of display mode; toggle only presentation.
why: Mode changes must not alter underlying signals.
test: Export parity with toggles.

title: Use one persistent dashboard
action: Allocate table once and update on last bar; calculate rolling values on all bars.
why: Avoid unnecessary object allocations and missing series history.
test: Profiler and mode toggle check.

title: Keep overlays sparse
action: Use grouped inputs, optional layers, stable color meaning and text/shape cues.
why: Readability is not the same as more information.
test: Review dark/light themes, dense charts and mobile.

title: Reuse drawings
action: Update persistent objects and delete expired ones instead of creating every bar.
why: Drawings have limits and cost.
test: Check object count and profiling.

title: Stable feature IDs
action: Define names, units, schema version, build, effective config, feed and times.
why: Agents need stable numeric contracts rather than screenshots.
test: Compare exported data and alert payload.

title: Serialize missing as JSON null
action: Use explicit null token and validate at receiver; reject NaN/Infinity and unescaped strings.
why: Invalid JSON and fake zeros contaminate models.
test: Offline JSON tests and actual alert check.

title: Respect alert snapshot
action: Recreate the alert when source, inputs or context change; include config/build ID.
why: Server-side alert uses saved context.
test: Test new and old configurations separately.

title: Separate ingestion from execution
action: Use sink-only HTTPS endpoint, durable queue and reconciliation; no credentials in payload; acknowledge within documented timeout.
why: Delivery can fail and alerts are not a guaranteed execution API.
test: Duplicate, missing, late and malformed messages.

title: Use CSV for historical samples
action: Export chart/indicator data where permitted; verify actual columns, history coverage and time alignment.
why: Realtime alert stream is not historical export.
test: Compare exact row timestamps and plot IDs.

title: Separate signal and fill time
action: Record order generation, actual simulated fill, and settings; do not assume signal close fills.
why: Broker emulator execution differs by order type and settings.
test: Strategy Tester trade list vs plotted event.

title: Explicit transaction friction
action: Set commission, slippage and size; model spreads/funding externally when necessary; test costs per side.
why: Gross edge can vanish after friction.
test: Stress costs and compare net baseline.

title: Use standard chart prices for baseline
action: Prefer ordinary candles for fill realism; document any synthetic chart use and emulator configuration.
why: Synthetic OHLC may not be executable prices.
test: Repeat on standard candles.

title: Stop semantics matter
action: Distinguish absolute price from tick distance, stop from limit and trailing activation from offset; verify API per version.
why: Unit errors distort orders and results.
test: Known-price trade fixture and fill review.

title: Check sizing units
action: For linear instrument cash risk divided by stop distance times point value, then round down; include costs, conversion and margin separately.
why: Different instruments have different payoff geometry.
test: Synthetic sizing fixture plus exchange metadata.

title: Do not optimize holdout
action: Separate chronological development/validation/test, record trials, compare baseline and test robustness.
why: Selection bias inflates apparent performance.
test: Review split boundaries and trial ledger.

title: Confluence is not independent by default
action: Group correlated momentum/trend features; require incremental out-of-sample benefit.
why: Multiple transforms of same price are redundant evidence.
test: Ablation and cost stress tests.

title: Reduce to minimal reproducible script
action: Isolate one compiler warning or runtime failure with same version and inputs; use logs selectively.
why: Smaller state space reveals root cause.
test: Save original error and corrected result.

title: Profile then optimize
action: Measure hot paths on same context; prefer built-ins when semantics match; update drawings; reduce repeated requests where valid.
why: Shorter code is not necessarily faster.
test: Repeated before/after profiling and parity checks.

title: Track resource budgets
action: Read current plot, object, execution and request limitations; prototype worst-case inputs.
why: Limits can vary by plan and release.
test: Worst-case stress and controlled failure.

title: Migrate one version at a time
action: Snapshot baseline and follow ordered migration guides, especially v5→v6 lazy eval and bool changes.
why: Silent changes may alter signals, not just syntax.
test: Compile and compare every intermediate where supported.

title: Use independent reconstruction
action: Predict, code, test, then read reference; record one counterexample and verify correction.
why: Reading alone does not demonstrate competence.
test: Evidence rubric and regression checks.
